## Change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior and any compatibility impact. Link a related issue when applicable.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. For conversion changes, cover the affected formats and input integrity. For panel changes, include browser checks or a screenshot with synthetic data.

## Checklist

- [ ] Examples and fixtures contain only synthetic authorization data.
- [ ] User-visible behavior and compatibility changes are documented, when applicable.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; any limitations are explained above.
